Thanks for taking this. We are preparing for our internal vendor review and have a couple of time-sensitive questions about Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage and an attestation for EU-only processing for our tenant. Specific asks below — could you confirm what evidence you can provide and an ETA?

If there are exceptions (e.g., control plane metadata in the US), please outline them and the contractual safeguards (SCCs, DPA sections, technical mitigations).

3) Evidence bundle request: we typically ask for (a) SOC 2 Type II report PDF, (b) a short attestation letter for audit teams, (c) a matrix showing data flows and regions, and (d) any KMS/HSM details and logging retention evidence. Please indicate which items you can deliver.

We are aiming to close procurement by 2026-11-20; if you can share a timeline for the items above that would be great.

- Residency: We support EU-only data plane processing for customer tenants provisioned in EU regions. The control plane (telemetry/alerts) is logically separated — minimal metadata may be processed outside the EU; SCCs and contractual language in our DPA cover that flow.
- Evidence: Attached are a one-page SOC2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_summary.pdf) and a residency matrix (redwood-residency-matrix.csv). Marissa can provide the full report under an NDA if needed; Neha will confirm the KMS key locations and logging retention.

Propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the attachments and confirm the attestation wording. Marissa / Neha — can one of you take point on delivering the full report and KMS/retention artifacts?
